class.name: VoxelBlockyLibraryBase
class.brief_description: Contains a list of models that can be used by [VoxelMesherBlocky].
class.description: Models used by [VoxelMesherBlocky] must be baked before they can be used efficiently at runtime. The way this process happens depends on the implementation of this class. It can be a simple list of models, or a list of high-level types generating variant models. Check child classes for more information.

method.name: bake
method.description: Bakes the library. The data of models is optimized in order to combine them more efficiently when generating voxel meshes.

method.name: get_materials
method.description: Gets a list of all distinct materials found in all models of the library. Note, if at least one non-empty model has no material, there will be one [code]null[/code] entry in this list to represent "The default material".

members.member: Shared bevel radius in voxel units, clamped to 0 through 0.25. Values below 0.001 are treated as zero to keep generated triangles stable at floating-point mesh precision. Zero disables rounding geometry. Only models with [member VoxelBlockyModel.rounding_enabled] enabled and supported cube geometry are affected. Bake the library and remesh affected terrain after changing this at runtime.

Distance in voxel units along an edge over which its bevel transitions to full width, clamped to 0.01 through 1.0. Values 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 and 1.0 mean 40%, 60%, 80% and 100% of one voxel edge. This setting is independent of the bevel radius. Bake the library and remesh affected terrain after changing this at runtime.
Shape of the edge transition over [member rounding_taper_distance], independent of [member rounding_amount]. Bake the library and remesh affected terrain after changing this at runtime.
Enable this option if you need normal mapping on your voxels. If you don't need it, disabling can reduce memory usage and give a small speed boost.

constants.constant: Linear transition: t. Here t is normalized distance through the taper.
Quadratic ease-in transition: t squared. Here t is normalized distance through the taper.
Quadratic ease-out transition: 1 minus (1 minus t) squared. Here t is normalized distance through the taper.
Smoothstep transition: t squared times (3 minus 2 times t). Here t is normalized distance through the taper.
